full_sentence: Right now, my brother is doing his homework in his room.
acceptable_variants: is reading a book on the sofa.
is watching a film in the living room.

options.why_wrong: 'Every day' describes a habit, but the stem says 'right now', which needs the present continuous.

options.text: is doing his homework in his room.

options.why_wrong: 'Yesterday' points to the past, but 'right now' points to the present.
'Tomorrow' points to the future, but 'right now' describes an action in progress.

grammar_focus: Present continuous for actions happening at the moment of speaking
explanation: The time expression 'right now' signals an action in progress, so the present continuous (am/is/are + verb-ing) is needed. Polish speakers may use a simple present form here because Polish has no separate continuous form.
